priority_items.title: NDRMO: meteorological drought now; El Niño contingency plans heading to Cabinet
priority_items.summary: FijiVillage homepage now leads NDRMO Director Napolioni Boseiwaqa: humanitarian clusters collating El Niño contingency plans for Cabinet; Fiji currently experiencing meteorological drought as stated; below-normal rainfall until early February; Taveuni water-carting via Government Shipping expected by the weekend. Not a drought-emergency gazette. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Hela 30-gun surrender (NBC 14:31 PGT) plus Nipa 19 (Haus Bung)
priority_items.summary: In-window NBC 14:31 PGT / 04:31 UTC now homepage lead: 30 high-powered illegal firearms surrendered in Hela and displayed in Tari during Independence celebrations. Governor Undialu cites ~500 factory-made illegal guns remaining and credits amnesty through December; Dec 7 ward-councillor assembly. Haus Bung: 19 firearms surrendered yesterday at Nipa Station, SHP. Provincial L&O. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: SEEP: 2–3 months not enough to implement Electoral Amendment Bill 2026
priority_items.summary: FijiVillage homepage #2: SEEP Research and Policy Officer Metuisela Gauna told the Justice committee in Labasa that two to three months may not be enough to implement Electoral Amendment Bill 2026 reforms before the next GE, despite supporting several changes. Says the election cannot be delayed; suggests introducing the bill next year. Distinct from the unpublished CRC Constitution path. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PINA 17 Sep roll: WIM ExCom Myazoe testimony; Talia fossil-fuel leftover
priority_items.summary: PINA homepage rolled to a 17 Sep set. In-window from 16:38 FJT / 04:38 UTC: Jerolynn Myazoe (RMI CCD) tells WIM ExCom 25 in Majuro that 1.5°C is survival, not a metric. Still no ExCom decision language. Adjacent Talia restatement that AUS fossil-fuel subsidies since 2020 were almost six times Pacific aid is PACNEWS/Australia Institute leftover, not a Forum instrument. Not FLASH.
